title: mirrorboard.toml
description: One organization's mirrorboard: its name, its owner, its config files and its departments.

name.description: The organization's name as people read it.

owner.description: The organization's account: account://<key of the accounts file>.

accounts.description: Path of the accounts file, relative to this file.

definitions.description: Path of the definitions file, relative to this file.

departments.description: Department files; the key is the department's name in addresses like agent://<department>/<agent>.

department.description: Path of the department file, relative to this file.
